values.binNote: The bin does not store this bonus as a separate flat/ratio pair; instead VayneCondemn.StunDamage=1.5 is a multiplier applied to the full TotalDamage (base+0.5xbonusAD) via EmpoweredDamageTT = TotalDamage*1.5, i.e. the terrain-collision hit replaces the base hit with 1.5x its damage rather than adding a distinct extra instance. The wiki instead presents this as an additional 'bonus' component (50%*1.5 base, 25% bonusAD extra ratio) on top of the base hit so total = base hit + bonus hit = TotalDamage*2.5. The values here are the wiki's stated bonus-only numbers (0.5x base, 0.25 bonusAD coef), derived as 1.5x-1x of the base formula; the bin encodes the same total via a single multiplier rather than an additive bonus term.

mechanics.claim: Condemn fires a projectile that knocks the target back; damage and the airborne effect apply on hit, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: fires a heavy bolt at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} 475 units, though not through terrain.

mechanics.claim: If the knocked-back target collides with terrain, it takes additional bonus physical damage on top of the base hit damage and is stunned; this requires terrain to be present.
mechanics.quote: If the target collides with [[terrain]], they take {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}|physical}} and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{ap|1.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: The knockback direction (and thus whether the target reaches terrain) is determined at the end of the cast time, not at the moment of cast.
mechanics.quote: Condemn's'' {{tip|airborne|displacement}} direction is determined at the end of the cast time.
